name: Pandino (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pandino (a lion rampant, counterchanged) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Pandino, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 19 December 1928.

features.role: Pandino arms — lion rampant counterchanged, crowned, within branches
